meta.name: Crosswind
meta.source: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics on-time data for 2013 departures from EWR, JFK and LGA, with FAA registry, airport list and NOAA hourly weather, via the nycflights13 package.

objectTypes.name: Airline
objectTypes.title: airline_name
objectTypes.description: A carrier operating flights out of New York.

objectTypes.name: Aircraft
objectTypes.title: aircraft_id
objectTypes.description: A registered airframe, identified by tail number.

objectTypes.name: Airport
objectTypes.title: airport_name
objectTypes.description: A New York origin or one of its destinations.

objectTypes.name: Delay
objectTypes.title: delay_id
objectTypes.description: A flight that left or arrived at least 15 minutes late.

objectTypes.name: Origin Day
objectTypes.title: origin_day_id
objectTypes.description: One New York airport on one day: operations and weather.

objectTypes.name: Route Alert
objectTypes.title: title
objectTypes.description: A detector finding on a route that someone should look at.

lineage.name: raw/flights
lineage.description: Every scheduled departure from EWR, JFK and LGA in 2013, as delivered (all text).
lineage.source: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics on-time data, via nycflights13

lineage.name: raw/airlines
lineage.description: Two-letter carrier codes and names.
lineage.source: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics on-time data, via nycflights13

lineage.name: raw/airports
lineage.description: US airports with coordinates and time zones.

lineage.name: raw/aircraft
lineage.description: Registry record per tail number: maker, model, year built, seats, engines.

lineage.name: raw/weather
lineage.description: Hourly surface weather at EWR, JFK and LGA.

lineage.name: raw/airports_supplement
lineage.description: Four Caribbean airports served from New York but absent from the airport list.

lineage.name: raw/carrier_lookup
lineage.description: Editorial classification of each carrier: network, low-cost or regional.

lineage.name: raw/distance_group_lookup
lineage.description: 250-mile distance bands, following the BTS distance-group scheme.

lineage.name: raw/delay_group_lookup
lineage.description: 15-minute delay bands, following the BTS delay-group scheme.

lineage.name: clean/flights
lineage.description: Typed flights. 'NA' becomes NULL, times become integers, and each flight gets a readable key.

lineage.name: clean/airlines
lineage.description: Carrier names with the legal suffix removed for display.

lineage.name: clean/airports
lineage.description: Airport list plus the four supplemented Caribbean airports, typed.

lineage.name: clean/aircraft
lineage.description: Registry records with maker names normalised (e.g. 'AIRBUS INDUSTRIE' and 'AIRBUS' become Airbus).

lineage.name: clean/weather
lineage.description: Typed hourly weather. One impossible wind reading (1,048 mph at EWR on 12 Feb) is nulled.

lineage.name: clean/carrier_lookup
lineage.description: Carrier type per carrier code.

lineage.name: clean/distance_group_lookup
lineage.description: Typed distance bands.

lineage.name: clean/delay_group_lookup
lineage.description: Typed delay bands.

lineage.name: processed/flights
lineage.description: Flights with derived fields: status, route, 15-minute delay flags and bands, distance band, calendar parts.

lineage.name: processed/aircraft
lineage.description: Aircraft with age in 2013 and a seat band.

lineage.name: processed/airports
lineage.description: Only the airports that New York flights actually touch, flagged as origin or destination.

lineage.name: processed/weather
lineage.description: Hourly weather with operational flags: low visibility (< 3 mi), precipitation, strong wind, freezing precipitation.

lineage.name: enriched/flights
lineage.description: The fan-in: one wide row per flight with airline, both airports, aircraft, band labels and the weather at the origin in the scheduled hour.

lineage.name: enriched/airports
lineage.description: Airports with traffic: departures, arrivals from New York, carriers and routes served.

lineage.name: delays/flights
lineage.description: The flight fact table handed to the ontology: keys, schedule, outcome and weather context.

lineage.name: delays/delays
lineage.description: One row per flight that left or arrived at least 15 minutes late, with phase, severity and minutes recovered in the air.

lineage.name: metrics/airline_fleet
lineage.description: Per airline and aircraft model: aircraft flown, flights, seats and build year. Registry-matched aircraft only.

lineage.name: metrics/airline_routes
lineage.description: Per airline and route: volume, cancellations, delays and on-time share.

lineage.name: metrics/airport_flights
lineage.description: Per airport, role (origin or destination) and month: volume, cancellations and delays.

lineage.name: metrics/route_daily
lineage.description: Per route and day: scheduled, cancelled, departed, arrived and delay totals. Feeds the alert detectors.

lineage.name: metrics/origin_daily
lineage.description: Per New York airport and day: operations plus the day's weather, and a robust disruption score against the previous 28 days.

lineage.name: metrics/hourly_profile
lineage.description: Per origin and scheduled departure hour: how delay builds through the day.

lineage.name: metrics/carrier_monthly
lineage.description: Per airline and month.

lineage.name: metrics/weather_delay
lineage.description: Departure delay and cancellation by the weather at the origin in the scheduled hour, binned four ways.

lineage.name: metrics/calendar_heat
lineage.description: Day of week by scheduled hour: where in the week delay concentrates.

lineage.name: metrics/distance_bands
lineage.description: Per distance band: delays and the minutes flights make up in the air.

lineage.name: alerts/route_alerts
lineage.description: Alerts raised by three detectors: route-specific delay spikes, cancellation clusters and chronically late weeks.

checks.name: alert volume is reviewable
checks.expected: between 100 and 2,500 alerts for the year

lineage.name: ontology/airline
lineage.description: Backing table for Airline.

lineage.name: ontology/aircraft
lineage.description: Backing table for Aircraft: registry-matched tail numbers that flew, with their main operator.

lineage.name: ontology/airport
lineage.description: Backing table for Airport: location, traffic and punctuality in its role.

lineage.name: ontology/route
lineage.description: Backing table for Route: an origin-destination pair with volume, punctuality and geometry.

lineage.name: ontology/origin_day
lineage.description: Backing table for Origin Day: one New York airport on one day, operations and weather together.

lineage.name: ontology/flight
lineage.description: Backing table for Flight: every raw record, with a foreign key to each linked object.

lineage.name: ontology/delay
lineage.description: Backing table for Delay: one per flight that ran at least 15 minutes late.

lineage.name: ontology/route_alert
lineage.description: Backing table for Route Alert. Every alert starts in the 'open' state; the app records triage on top.

lineage.name: ontology/airline_route
lineage.description: Join table behind the many-to-many link between Airline and Route.
